items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I worked over there with Sonny Criss, with a nice group over there.

ctx.x: Right, San Pedro Street and First; First and San Pedro. And the Downtown House was next to it. And across the street was the Civic Hotel; I lived in the Civic Hotel. And that's when two young saxophone players used to come, and they were too young to come in, they'd come in the back door and stand up against the wall, and listen to me play. It was Big Jay McNeely, the tenor player, and Sonny Criss, the alto saxophone player. They were still in high school, the last year of high school. And later on, Sonny told me…
